quest.title: The Story of "the Princess" and "the Adventure Team"
quest.description: You have met many members from the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team and have worked hard to successfully rescue the "Princess." Now go to the "magical fountain" mentioned by Ann, and board the water entity in mid-air.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.num: Ann of the Narzissenkreuz: Act I
chapter.title: The Narzissenkreuz Adventure

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Weren't we just flying up into the sky in a bubble?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Yes, we were.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And we kept going up, and up, and up, until we crashed headfirst into the water, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Yes. Is there something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, there's so much wrong with this that Paimon doesn't even know where to start...

choices.text: Perhaps this is just one of the kingdom's magical aspects.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh. You know what? Paimon's just not gonna ask! The Princess's treasure should be around here somewhere, right?

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Yes. It is there, protected by a three-layered seal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Where? Oh, you mean that? Hmm, while that outer bubble is pretty big, the treasure seems to be inside a really small chest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And it looks like there are some threads of flowing water connected to the big bubble...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: It seems as if the Bubble Formation here will not attack us. Hmm, in that case, let's use it to break the seals!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: We just need to <color=#00E1FFFF>guide its projectiles to the bubble rings connected to the flowing water</color>. That should transfer the force of the projectile through the water and weaken the seals.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, those bubbles are pretty scary...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: One, two, three... Looks like there are <color=#00E1FFFF>three strands of water</color>. Once we deal with them, the treasure should be ours!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: #That's right. It's in your hands, Knight {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

choices.text: No one wishes to have their soul weighed down by gravity.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: We've finally found it... The most precious of treasures...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like a pocketwatch.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like it's not moving anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it has been in water all this time, so it should've broken down long ago, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: This is... full of Princess Lyris's precious time.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Let's go back to the tower and meet up with our friends.

dialogues.speaker: Petit Chou
dialogues.text: You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Al
dialogues.text: Colonel Kate and Mori linked up with us while you were out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe. We're back with the Princess's treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Colonel Kate
dialogues.text: Well done, soldier! You've made a fine contribution. The Resistance Front is proud of you!

dialogues.speaker: Al
dialogues.text: Kate, now isn't the time...

dialogues.speaker: Jak
dialogues.text: #Not so fast, "Colonel." {NICKNAME} is a contact of the Orchestre, not cannon-fodder from some no-name army.

dialogues.speaker: Colonel Kate
dialogues.text: #Ha! Your orchestra couldn't hold {NICKNAME}. Not unless you wanted to name it after {M#him}{F#her} instead!

dialogues.speaker: Jak
dialogues.text: #Hmph! And what of your rank? You may as well give it to {NICKNAME}, no?

dialogues.speaker: Jak
dialogues.text: The soldiers bleed while commanders steal the glory. This is quite ordinary. But you, now you're special! A "colonel" who not only does nothing, but even lets his troops take credit for victory!

dialogues.speaker: Colonel Kate
dialogues.text: You...! While you were whiling your time away here, I was taking out the Bubble Formations in the waters above. If not for that, they would not have gained the treasure so easily!

choices.text: Stop fighting over me, all of you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you sound like a female protagonist in a novel! Well, uh, how about this? Let's just call the organizations Colonel Paimon's Resistance Front and the Orchestre Paimon!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Ugh! That's it, I'm done! Mori, get him!

response.speaker: Mori
response.text: Woof, woof! Bad person!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Mori bowls Jak over.\n\n

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Mori bowls Jak over.\nKate laughs at him...\nOnly to also be knocked over by Mori.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The altercation is eventually calmed by Al and Petit Chou's mediation.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Honestly...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mori's really reliable at times like this, uh... Y'know, in some ways...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's get to business, shall we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! We'll get nowhere if we keep arguing, and the more we go nowhere, the more we're gonna argue...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Yes... You're both right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's have a speech then, Ann! Y'know, the rousing kind!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Eh? But...

response.speaker: Al
response.text: I approve of Paimon's suggestion. Is it not at such times that an adventure team's leader should step up to the plate?

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: But I'm not good at speeches... and can you really call me the "leader"...?

response.speaker: Colonel Kate
response.text: As surely as I am a colonel, I affirm that you would be the best officer for this adventure team.

response.speaker: Jak
response.text: My views on the title of "Colonel" aside, we are in accord.

response.speaker: Petit Chou
response.text: #I... I don't know much about leaders, or glory, or whatever, but if not for you, and if not for {NICKNAME} and Paimon, whom you brought here, I don't know what would've become of me...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: #Knight {NICKNAME}, Paimon, what do you say?

choices.text: This is what everyone wants.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Hmm... Well, in that case, what should a leader say in times like this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let Paimon think... Since we have Princess Lyris's treasure, next, we just need to enter the tower and rescue her, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you just need to encourage everyone to do just that before we start.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: #Paimon, do you have any interest in being leader? How about you, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, hey, you can't do that!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Why not? If not for your strength, we wouldn't have made it this far...

choices.text: We're just here to support you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whatever the case, only you can be the leader of this adventure team. That's what everyone wants, so stop trying to push it off to someone else!

response.speaker: Everyone
response.text: We'll support you!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Ohh, alright, alright! Ugh, this "leader" business used to be so much easier...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Ahem.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: No matter what the name of our organization is, we're all part of the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team. We have a common goal, to rescue Princess Lyris...

response.speaker: Jak
response.text: Ms. Lyris.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: ...Or Ms. Lyris, and we intend to save the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom...

response.speaker: Jak
response.text: Republic...

response.speaker: Mori
response.text: *growls threateningly*

response.speaker: Jak
response.text: *cough* Please continue, Ann.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: And restore the land and waters here to their original gleaming shimmer through the Reconquista, so that the sunflowers may once more flourish. Am I not right about that?

response.speaker: Everyone, Even Jak
response.text: That's right!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: We've experienced many battles and partings during the long years of conflict, and many team members we once had are no longer with us.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: But I won't forget the times we spent together. We'll always be friends.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: That's right. Even if I am our leader, I am everyone's friend first and foremost.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: The same goes for you, Colonel Kate, Jak. Don't forget your friendship over differences in ideals and perspectives.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Ann's being super mature right now, huh?)

choices.text: Bravo! *applauds*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bravo!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Come on, stop teasing me!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: #With Knight {NICKNAME} and Paimon's aid, we were finally able to obtain the Princess's treasure. Time that was once frozen will flow again, and we will rescue her.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: #For that, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, I thank you. You will always be our friends. I believe that our Princess would also be glad to call you such.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: O—Okay, I'm done now...

response.speaker: Everyone
response.text: Bravo!

choices.text: Bravo! *applauds*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nice! Alright. What do we do next?

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Well now... I think it's time to unleash the treasure's power on the stagnant tower. This way, its "time" should flow once more.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Like this?

response.speaker: Petit Chou
response.text: Whoa...

response.speaker: Al
response.text: #My thanks, {NICKNAME}. Now...

response.speaker: Al
response.text: Unfortunately, I fear that none of us{RUBY#[S]Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team} know what will happen next.

response.speaker: Petit Chou
response.text: But since the Princess's tower has been unsealed, we should move as soon as we can, right?

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Right you are, Petit Chou. Let's go!

choices.text: Aye, what next?
(That can't have been easy.)
I'm not going to overstep on what's been a relaxing time so far.
Wouldn't that make me a "Grand Master" of sorts?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Eh, that seems tiring. Forget it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you do become one someday, don't forget to make Paimon an Honorary Knight!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, now that's a title Paimon can get behind!

choices.text: This is between you and them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME} means that since everyone says so, you should just accept!

choices.text: I've heard enough. See you around.
Let's get this straight first. I didn't join any of you...

talks.objective: Talk to the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team
Talk to the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why do Narcissus's little minions all need so many titles?

dialogues.speaker: Jak
dialogues.text: The more useless the person, the more hats they need.

dialogues.speaker: Al
dialogues.text: Actually, they are mighty warriors who have caused us much harm during previous engagements. If the battle seemed easy, it was due to your great might.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: #Sorry, Knight {NICKNAME}, but our attacks can do nothing against these henchmen, so it is all up to you.

choices.text: Easy-peasy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Y'know, where is Princess Lyris? Doesn't look like there's any path ahead.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: To be honest, I didn't think this far either...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Let's... keep going up, shall we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How do we do that?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can fly up there, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, even if Paimon could do that... What would she do if she encountered Narcissus's minions?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And even if all the kingdom's treasures were up there... It would only feel like we found them if you were there, too!

response.speaker: Al
response.text: Go up, you say... Ah, I understand. We do, one and all, have a certain amount of power. It is all magic given to us by the Princess, yes, but we can do some things with it.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: But if we do...

response.speaker: Jak
response.text: We were all born from the same source. I don't see why you would be unable to understand and accept this. Has this not happened before?

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: I know, I know all this... in theory. But I just hate these things. I don't know why, but I just do.

response.speaker: Petit Chou
response.text: Don't make such a face, Ann. We were born from the same waters, and we are only this way because...

response.speaker: Petit Chou
response.text: We bound ourselves into different shapes using thin films to keep the Princess company. Coming together once again for her sake is not strange at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait. What are you all talking about?

response.speaker: Al
response.text: As long as we forsake our forms and join together, we can produce greater magic. This way, we can send you to the tower's apex.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, but if you do that—

response.speaker: Al
response.text: You need not worry, friend. We came from the same body of water, so giving up our forms is not the same as what you would call "death." Pure waters can turn into creatures of all sorts, and such changes do not only go one way.

response.speaker: Petit Chou
response.text: Yup! Even if we cannot adventure or fight alongside you, we can still progress together!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: #Knight {NICKNAME}, Paimon, what do you say?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is not our decision to make.

choices.text: Only you can decide what your adventure team will do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You're right, {NICKNAME}, but...

response.speaker: Colonel Kate
response.text: Give us our orders, ma'am! The tower seals have been broken, which means they can no longer hold Narcissus back. Every moment counts!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Alright. I'm counting on you all.

response.speaker: Colonel Kate
response.text: Orders received!

response.speaker: Petit Chou
response.text: #Leave it to us! Go with {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Ann. Make sure you save the Princess!

response.speaker: Jak
response.text: Hmph. I leave Ms. Lyris in your hands.

response.speaker: Al
response.text: In that case, dear Petit Chou...

response.speaker: Al
response.text: Mori, Colonel Kate, and Jak...

response.speaker: Mori
response.text: Okay. Bye-bye.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, it's just like what happened at Mori's fountain...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Our power is derived from the Princess. If so resolved, we can manifest it once more...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: #Ugh. Pull yourself together, Ann! Let's go, Knight {NICKNAME}, Paimon!

choices.text: Only you can decide whether we proceed or not.
This is your story.
Bit of a close shave, I'd say.

talks.objective: Reach the top floor of the tower
Reach the top floor of the tower

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? It's just a portal... Where does this one lead, though?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm not sure either, to be honest. I have never considered what would happen after we entered the tower.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Oh well. In that case, let's proceed with caution.

choices.text: With more proceeding or more caution?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on! Both!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Yes. We should be careful. We're the only ones the Princess can rely on.

choices.text: Let's see what's on the other side.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's... kinda... dizzy. There are so many books here...

choices.text: Is this a library?

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: This place... This library has existed since long, long before we arrived.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Their contents seem to be ancient dramas. Children love to read books, but there is much they won't understand, so they will often ask adults to read the stories to them.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: In the books, where there is an evil dragon, there must be heroes who hunt the dragon. If there is a mage, there must be a wandering knight. The Reconquista must come to pass, and the princess must be saved.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: And of course, a chime will sound, and the tale of adventure will come to a halt.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Yet it will not end. There will be another adventure, and another, and another one after that, until the children grow up and leave this place.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ann?

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Huh? I... Sorry, it felt like memories and feelings suddenly... flooded into my mind. How strange.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Well, as long as you're alright... Paimon thought you might have been bewitched by Narcissus's magic or something!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Urk. That might actually be so!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmmm... Well, what do we do next?

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: I'm not sure either...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Whatever the case, let's have a look around.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup. First off... Huh, there's a door over there, but it looks like there's no way through it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You two should be able to get across.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, you're Ann's knight right now, you know. This will all be pointless if you don't come along!

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: That's right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This tile sticks out like a sore thumb...

choices.text: This might be some sort of path.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't know either... But let's go, all the same!

choices.text: This might be a trap...
Is this a bookstore?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What makes you think there'd be secret underground bookstore ruins anywhere in Fontaine?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Maybe a little warning next time?
